summary.short_summary: Client retention is a pressing issue, with average retention duration dropping below two months, contrasting Amanda's success with Skyview. The meeting highlighted the need for a new business model centered on deal flow acquisition and content creation for YouTube, moving away from traditional agency services. A three-tier pricing structure was proposed, featuring the Pinnacle Tier at $12k for a three-month deal engine build, an Accelerator Tier at $2.5k monthly for maintenance, and a DIY Tier priced at $500/$750 monthly for self-service clients. An integrated platform launching next week will enhance communication through LinkedIn, email, SMS, and WhatsApp, alongside AI features. Weekly training calls and open mic sessions aim to boost community engagement, while a strategic sales process will initiate at the $12k price point, ensuring clear communication about onboarding and transitions with clients awaiting the new platform's launch.
